the-news 1.0.1

- Added metadata file (_meta.json) for improved integration and management.
- No changes to skill logic or user-facing behavior.

- Initial release of "the-news" skill, providing API access to current main headlines from newspapers and news sites in 20 countries.
- Supports live, near real-time updates and historical headline snapshots via a simple, public API.
- Offers a country-organized newsstand view, delivering multi-source, timestamped headline snapshots with AI-generated contextual overviews.
- Enables daily overview queries and comparison of story flow over user-defined time ranges.
- Designed for efficient breaking news checks, cross-country analysis, and historical headline research without requiring authentication.
